title: Real density limit at a weighted approximate tangent point (Simon 3.1.8(2))
statement: Let n ≥ 1 and U ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} open. Let V = v(M, θ) be a RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U, x ∈ U, and P a subspace with Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x P. Then r⁻ⁿ ∫_{M ∩ B_r(x)} θ dHⁿ → ω_n·θ(x) in ℝ as r ↓ 0 (along 𝓝[>] 0). Here B_r(x) is the closed ball, Hⁿ = μHE[n] and ω_n = unitBallVolume n.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (x : Amb n ℓ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)), x ∈ U → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n V.carrier V.mult x P → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ z in V.carrier ∩ closedBall x r, V.mult z ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (unitBallVolume n * V.mult x))
